purpose: Revalidate the exhausted three-session factor frontier after the terminal CNInfo equity-incentive full-source gate and select at most one economically independent, currently authorized no-return mechanism before any provider row, factor value, price, or return is observed.

candidate_review.reason: The official fund_portfolio interface requires 5000 points, above the current 3000-point authorization. No purchase, provider row, holding value, price, or return is authorized.
The official cyq_perf interface requires 5000 points, above current authorization; it is not probed or approximated from prices.
The official hm_detail interface requires 10000 points and begins only in August 2022; it is outside current authorization and cannot satisfy the fixed seven-year development protocol.

A monthly 2019-2025 rebalance/change event has at most 84 dated snapshots before quality, listing, name, and distinct-value gates, below the fixed minimum of 200 non-overlapping three-session cohorts.

candidate_review.documented_availability: source trade-date data is loaded before 09:00 on the next trading day
candidate_review.economic_mechanism: three-local-session change in the number of CCASS clearing participants holding one security, representing breadth of cross-border custody participation rather than amount ownership, issuer attention, classified order flow, valuation, fundamentals, or price action
candidate_review.current_operability_caveat: The documentation provides an A-share example and all-history claim but does not prove that the current response covers both supported Shanghai and Shenzhen A-share boards. The acceptance must prove both exchanges at historical and latest local anchors or terminate.
candidate_review.relationship_to_terminal_hk_hold: The terminal hk_hold idea measured aggregate Northbound ownership stock and was rejected because its daily disclosure stopped. This candidate uses only the CCASS participant-count field from a separately documented next-morning clearing dataset. It never uses shareholding or hold_ratio; failure to reproduce both exchanges and the latest anchor terminates rather than substituting the discontinued ownership series.
candidate_review.independence_reason: CCASS participant breadth counts clearing/custody participants on every observed security-day. Existing survey and analyst counts measure disclosed attention events; major-holder and holder-number factors measure issuer ownership disclosures; classified moneyflow measures transaction-size flow; size and liquidity factors measure trading capacity. No participant identity, holding quantity, ownership percentage, price, market cap, report text, or return enters the candidate.

pass one fixed sixteen-session acceptance covering four four-session anchors across 2019, 2024, 2025, and the latest local 2026 session
prove current and historical Shanghai-main, Shenzhen-main, ChiNext, and current STAR source transport without using names or identities
freeze a fingerprint-bound 2019-2025 atomic full-source and no-return capacity protocol only after acceptance
pass source coverage, 200-cohort capacity, and semantic/statistical uniqueness before any price or forward return
freeze one immutable single-factor return diagnostic before any future quote access
